_comment: Reference config for the Fermi Agent Bestiary MCP server. The live config Zed actually reads is at ~/.config/zed/settings.json under `context_servers`. This file is the canonical version — copy the `mcpServers.fermi-agent-bestiary` block into your settings.json (translating to Zed's `context_servers` shape — same fields, different parent key).

_tools: list_agents        — List all curated agents (79 as of 2026-05-19) with metadata
get_agent          — Get detailed info for a specific agent (by agent_id)
execute_agent      — Run an agent with a query (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
save_agent         — Save agent stats to disk + git commit
search_agents      — Search by keyword, tag, type, or tier
get_catalogue      — Full catalogue grouped by category with composition patterns
ask_xaman_ek       — Ask the platform navigator anything (78 specimens registered)
fermi-agent-bestiary._rebuild_note: After pulling new commits from main, rebuild the binary so the MCP server picks up code changes and new agents: `cargo build --bin agent-mcp-server` from /home/ilabra/fermi. The agent count, the xaman_ek system prompt, and the executor (which Ollama support, observability annotation, and honest-economics for local providers now ride through) all bake in at startup. Then restart Zed (Cmd/Ctrl-Shift-P → 'context server: restart' or quit + relaunch).
